image_description: A close-up, cropped view of a green transparent audio cassette tape. The image shows the top half of the cassette body with two visible spools inside circular windows. Below the green casing is a beige/tan strip featuring several rectangular cutouts and holes, resembling the bottom mechanism or a stylized representation of the tape head access area. There is white text on the green label area that appears distorted and illegible.

The bottom part of the cassette does not resemble a real cassette's mechanical interface. Instead of a smooth sliding door or specific cutouts, it features irregular, non-functional holes and a strange separation from the main body.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundary between the green plastic and the beige strip is slightly soft and lacks the precise molding lines expected in manufactured plastic parts.
